single.rationale: IDEXX demonstrates strong fundamental performance with consistent revenue growth (8.5% 3-year CAGR), excellent margins (32% operating, 62% gross), and robust cash generation (25% FCF margin). However, the premium valuation (50x P/E, 51x P/FCF) leaves limited margin for error, and management flags near-term headwinds including declining vet clinic visits (-2% in 2025, expected to continue in 2026), macroeconomic pressures, and veterinary practice capacity constraints that are constraining volume growth despite strong market position.
